verdict.rationale: Rainforest's docs cover payment processing, deposits, amount splits, and merchant billing, but there is no evidence of an escrow-like mechanism that holds seller funds until delivery or dispute windows pass, nor documented release triggers/limits for such holds. Deposit frequency (rainforest-docs-7) and amount splits (rainforest-docs-6/28) address payout timing and fund routing among parties, not conditional fund-holding tied to delivery confirmation or dispute resolution.
